title: fix(runtime): the organization-ownership boot refusals say what 18.0 supports and name no step of the withdrawn ceremony command
body:
Fixes #24651
Clause-②: no (refusal text only: the refusal code `ORGANIZATION_OWNERSHIP_MIGRATION_REQUIRED`, the refused tables and the boot outcome do not move)

In 18.0, `os migrate organization-ownership` refuses plan and apply on every database (`ORGANIZATION_OWNERSHIP_UPGRADE_UNAVAILABLE`, `NOT_IMPLEMENTED`). Three branches of the v18 boot refusal in `packages/runtime/src/organization-ownership-boot-guard.ts` still sent the operator to that command's `--out PLAN` and `--apply --plan-file PLAN --backup-taken`. Each branch now closes on the sentence the landed member of this family (PR #24635, `f89d29e38`) put into `os migrate apply`'s drop gate and `os dev`'s way on:

> 18.0 supports fresh installs only and does not upgrade a v17 database: keep a v17 database on a 17.x release until the 18.x release that carries the upgrade path, and upgrade it there.

A development boot (`{ dev: true }`, as `os serve --dev` composes the guard) says "a v17 development database", the exact wording of the landed `os dev` text. No branch names the command or any step of it. `ceremonyCommand()` (which only built the `--dev` command name) is gone. The `dev` option stays, and still changes the text. The refusal code, the refused tables, `isOrganizationOwnershipBootRefusal`, the plugin's ordering and every boot outcome are unchanged. This is the `domain:cli` row of the family close-out #24637.

## Branch map

| branch | selected when | source | refused tables |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **A, v17 shape** | `findV17ShapeTables` finds a table whose object declares no organization column (`systemFields.tenant: false`, no declared `organization_id`) but still has a physical `organization_id`, and the marker is absent, unverified or unreadable | `organizationOwnershipRefusalMessage`, `tables` not empty (was about `:252`–`:258`) | the tables found |
| **B1, marker not verified** | no table in the v17 shape, and the `sys_migration` row `adr-0131-organization-ownership` exists but is not verified: a ceremony ran every step and its post-check found discrepancies | `organizationOwnershipRefusalMessage`, `tables` empty, marker `unverified` (was about `:239`–`:243`) | none |
| **B2, marker unreadable** | no table in the v17 shape, and a store serves the ledger but its read of the marker threw | the same return as B1, marker `unreadable` (was about `:239`–`:243`) | none |
| **C, column read failed** | `findV17ShapeTables` itself threw while reading a table's columns | `assertOrganizationOwnershipMigrated`'s `catch` (was about `:339`–`:344`) | none |

The card's ":242" is B1 and B2 (one return statement), ":256–257" is A, and ":342–343" is C. A marker that is absent with no v17 table, and a verified marker, still boot.

## Before and after, per branch

Rendered by importing the guard at `bfc1539fe` (before) and at this PR's head (after) and calling it. TABLES stands for the table list. The `--dev` before-texts are the same with `os migrate organization-ownership --dev`.

**A, v17 shape** (marker absent; unverified and unreadable differ only in the state clause)

- Before: "This database is still in the v17 organization-ownership shape: TABLES still carry a physical organization_id column, and the ceremony has not run on it. The server refuses to start rather than serve v17 data with v18 semantics. 18.0 does not upgrade a v17 database: keep this one on a 17.x release until the 18.x release that carries the upgrade path, and run these steps there. Run 'os migrate organization-ownership --out PLAN' to write and review its plan, take a backup, then run 'os migrate organization-ownership --apply --plan-file PLAN --backup-taken', and start again. To keep 17.x semantics, run a 17.x runtime."
- After: "This database is still in the v17 organization-ownership shape: TABLES still carry a physical organization_id column, and the ceremony has not run on it. The server refuses to start rather than serve v17 data with v18 semantics. 18.0 supports fresh installs only and does not upgrade a v17 database: keep a v17 database on a 17.x release until the 18.x release that carries the upgrade path, and upgrade it there."
- What was kept: everything up to "v18 semantics", and the 17.x answer. What was dropped: the two steps, "run these steps there", and "To keep 17.x semantics, run a 17.x runtime.", which now repeats "keep a v17 database on a 17.x release".

**B1, marker not verified**

- Before: "The organization-ownership ceremony has not finished on this database: its marker (sys_migration 'adr-0131-organization-ownership') is not verified: the post-check still found rows the ceremony has not carried. The server refuses to start rather than serve rows of an organization-owned object with no organization. Resolve what the apply report names, then run 'os migrate organization-ownership --out PLAN' again, review it, run 'os migrate organization-ownership --apply --plan-file PLAN --backup-taken', and start again."
- After: "The organization-ownership ceremony has not finished on this database: its marker (sys_migration 'adr-0131-organization-ownership') is not verified: the post-check still found rows the ceremony has not carried. The server refuses to start rather than serve rows of an organization-owned object with no organization. 18.0 supports fresh installs only and does not upgrade a v17 database: keep a v17 database on a 17.x release until the 18.x release that carries the upgrade path, and upgrade it there."
- Dropped: "Resolve what the apply report names", the re-plan and the re-apply. In 18.0 nothing can verify the marker, so resolving the report's rows does not let this database boot. The 18.x release finishes the ceremony.

**B2, marker unreadable**

- Before: the B1 text with "its marker (sys_migration 'adr-0131-organization-ownership') could not be read" as the state. It prescribed the same re-plan and re-apply.
- After: "The organization-ownership ceremony has not finished on this database: its marker (sys_migration 'adr-0131-organization-ownership') could not be read. The server refuses to start rather than serve rows of an organization-owned object with no organization. Fix the read, then start again. 18.0 supports fresh installs only and does not upgrade a v17 database: keep a v17 database on a 17.x release until the 18.x release that carries the upgrade path, and upgrade it there."
- Added: "Fix the read, then start again." This branch also reaches a fresh 18.0 database whose ledger read failed: no v17 table, and a marker the guard could not read. On that database the true way on is the read. Once the read answers, a database with no marker boots. The old text sent it to an apply report it never had.

**C, column read failed**

- Before: "The server refuses to start: it could not read whether this database is still in the v17 organization-ownership shape (ERROR), and an unread answer is never taken for a migrated database. Fix the read, or run the ceremony ('os migrate organization-ownership --out PLAN', then 'os migrate organization-ownership --apply --plan-file PLAN --backup-taken'), then start again."
- After: "The server refuses to start: it could not read whether this database is still in the v17 organization-ownership shape (ERROR), and an unread answer is never taken for a migrated database. Fix the read, then start again. 18.0 supports fresh installs only and does not upgrade a v17 database: keep a v17 database on a 17.x release until the 18.x release that carries the upgrade path, and upgrade it there."
- Kept: "Fix the read". Dropped: the command as the alternative.

## Census: `packages/runtime`

`git grep -n -E "migrate organization-ownership|--plan-file|--out PLAN|backup-taken|ceremony" -- packages/runtime` at the base, every hit read:

| location | what it is | disposition |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `organization-ownership-boot-guard.ts` about `:242`, `:256`–`:257`, `:342`–`:343` | the three branches | changed (above) |
| `organization-ownership-boot-guard.ts:110` `ceremonyCommand()` | built the command name the refusals interpolated | removed. The `dev` option now selects "development database". |
| `organization-ownership-boot-guard.ts:19`, `standalone-stack.ts:336` | code comments that describe the ceremony | excluded (comments). The module docblock sentence beside `:19` ("says which command to run") was corrected anyway, because it described this behaviour. |
| `packages/runtime/CHANGELOG.md` `:473`, `:481`, `:912` (and `:296`, `:444`, `:900`, `:913`) | released entries naming the ceremony's steps | not changed. Release-owned, never edited in a code PR (AGENTS.md, Documentation Guardrails). Each entry records what its release shipped. |
| `seed-loader-null-organization-holder-real-driver.integration.test.ts:215` | a runtime test pinning `'os migrate organization-ownership'` in `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`'s seed-loader refusal | not changed. The string lives in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts`, outside this lane (see Acceptance notes) |
| everything else (`action-execution.ts`, `domain-handler-registry.ts`, `flow-clone.ts`, `sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts`, `security/security-catalog.testkit.ts`) | the word "ceremony" in unrelated comments | not this family |
| `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json`, item `platform-core.v18-boot-refusals` (outside `packages/runtime`) | a QA checklist item whose title and `acceptance[1]` expected the refusal to name the command | changed in patch round 1 (revision 4, `21f7e90f4`) |

**Met and not pre-empted:** branch A also reaches a database that 18.0 itself created, when one of its objects newly declares `systemFields: { tenant: false }`. This PR still calls such a database "still in the v17 organization-ownership shape". The 17.x sentence is false for that database, and this PR adds no sentence for it. That wording is the open maintainer decision in #24638, and #24638 remains open.

## Pins and the ablation

- `organization-ownership-boot-guard.test.ts`: the old pins on the command text are rewritten. A new block holds one pin per branch: A (absent, unverified and unreadable markers), B1, B2, C, and a development boot across all four. Each asserts the refusal code, the closing text (B2 and C with "Fix the read, then start again." before it), and that the message matches none of `os migrate organization-ownership`, `--plan-file`, `--out PLAN`, `--backup-taken`.
- `organization-ownership-boot-guard.kernel.test.ts`: case 4 (B1 on a real kernel) asserted `--apply --plan-file PLAN --backup-taken`. It now asserts the 18.0 sentence and the absence.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/organization-ownership-boot-refusal-order.dogfood.test.ts` step 1 asserted the refusal contains `'os migrate organization-ownership'`. It now asserts the 18.0 sentence and the absence. Dogfood runs only on `main`'s full battery, not on this PR's CI, so it was run locally (below).
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json`, item `platform-core.v18-boot-refusals`, revision 3 to 4 (patch round 1, commit `21f7e90f4`): the title and `acceptance[1]` (clause, verify) asserted that the refusal names `os migrate organization-ownership`. They now assert the named tables, the closing 18.0 sentence, and 0 hits for `--out PLAN`, `--plan-file` and the command. The ⛔ on the code literal is kept, and a history row cites #24682.
- **Ablation**, on the committed head `7ac4f50e9`: `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` put branch C's old "Fix the read, or run the ceremony ('os migrate organization-ownership --out PLAN', then '… --apply --plan-file PLAN --backup-taken'), then start again." back. On disk: anchor x1 to x0, replacement x0 to x1, blob `65f1c9e2` to `dad453f6`. The unit file then ran 2 failed and 20 passed. The red pins were "a column read that failed: fix the read first" and "a development boot says the same … in every branch". The restore leg: blob back to `65f1c9e2` (HEAD), `git diff HEAD` empty. The unit test imports the guard by relative path (source), so no build or `dist` leg applies.

## Tests and gates (code at `7ac4f50e9`; the union, wide families, lint and dogfood re-run at `21f7e90f4`, the final commit)

- `@objectstack/runtime`, every project: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test` (project `local`) passed 425 files, 6676 tests, 19 skipped. `test:repo` (project `repo`) passed 3 files, 808 tests. `typecheck` passed: `tsc --noEmit`, plus `check:test-typecheck` OK with the debt ledger held. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists both edited test files.
- `@objectstack/cli`, the tests that read the boot refusal (`apply.organization-ownership-refusal.test.ts`, `organization-ownership.no-organization.integration.test.ts`, `organization-ownership.declared-rule-mirrors.integration.test.ts`), against runtime's rebuilt `dist`: 3 files and 8 tests passed. The runtime `dist` carries the new sentence and has 0 hits of `--apply --plan-file PLAN`.
- `@objectstack/dogfood`, `test/organization-ownership-boot-refusal-order.dogfood.test.ts`, run once at this head after its closure built (66 tasks, exit 0): 1 file and 5 tests passed.
- Derived gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` named 68 commands, and each exit was captured before any pipe. 67 exited 0 on the first pass. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3), because not every package had a `dist`. After the whole-repo build it was re-run and exited 0 (111 require entry points across 69 packages load). `--ran` reconciliation: "68 derived, 68 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". At `21f7e90f4` the new path adds `pnpm check:platform-checklist` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions`. The derivation named 70 commands, and all 70 exited 0 after the whole-repo build was restored from cache. `--ran`: "70 derived, 70 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN".
- Declared-wide families, all 11 exited 0: `check:init-service-contract`, `check:live-db-isolation`, `check:meta-type-normalized`, `check:optional-error-sink`, `check:resume-authority-declared`, `check:route-envelope`, `check:runner-env-posture`, `check:settings-bind-window`, `check:startup-registry-verdict`, `check:verify-stand-in`, `check:wildcard-fallthrough`. `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`) exited 0. At `21f7e90f4` all 11 and `pnpm lint` were re-run and exited 0.
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs --changed-from origin/main` exited 0 at both heads: 3 anchors judged, 0 lost. At `21f7e90f4`, `pnpm check:platform-checklist` exited 0 ("16 areas, 327 items"). `@objectstack/plugin-auth`'s `checklist-refusal-envelope-consistency.test.ts`, which reads every area file, passed 1 file and 5 tests. The dogfood file re-run at `21f7e90f4` passed 1 file and 5 tests.
- `origin/main` has moved since this branch was cut, but nothing new touches these files, so `main` was not merged in.

## Acceptance notes

- **Same family, outside `packages/runtime` and outside #24637's rows.** The parent's census regex does not match a backtick right after the command name, so it misses two strings. `packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts:1739` (the seed loader's unowned-holder refusal) says "(`os migrate organization-ownership`, then the same command with --apply)". `packages/metadata-core/src/legacy-organization-row.ts:78` (`LegacyOrganizationRowsUnreadable`) says "Run `os migrate organization-ownership` on this database first." Both are reported to the seat to fold into #24637. They are not changed here.
- **The QA checklist clause this PR made stale is fixed here.** Patch round 1 used the seat's in-place exemption: conditions ① to ④ hold, and the seat measured ③. See Pins.
- The pending changeset `15214-c11-fresh-install-messages.md` (#24506) put the 18.0 sentence ahead of the steps. It is left as it is: it correctly describes its own change, and this PR's changeset describes the removal of the steps.
